reason: The finding changes no decision, and the two card texts it proposes are factually wrong. (1) Its action (3) says R28-RC-C's 'A first at exactly 0.954' and 'central +0.0002' stand. Round 28 REFUTED R28-RC-C (round28/v_recheck_r28-rc-c-ci-private-prior-trimmed-dummy-la.json; REPORT.md 'Rejected'). Action (2) was dropped as a post-hoc change to the pre-registered EXP75 PARTNER RULE v2. The standing prior is P(>=0) 0.65-0.75 with central +0.0005. Rule v2 (CONTEXT 14:12Z) already puts A first only when exp75 = 0.954 AND probe 51 reads '-'. Restoring the refuted unconditional wording would go against R1-R10. (2) 'A differs mainly in fork-set levers and nearly coincides on a 44b6-like embryo' is false. V_pub = exp85a = #37 + cap 6 + ILP_DIVISION_WEIGHT 0.4 + READMIT_MIN_SCORE 0.94. The probe-50 decomposition (CONTEXT l.3489) shows that almost all of exp85a's change comes from READMIT 0.94 (+1,022 nodes, lowrefine refined +3.05%). That is a node/coordinate lever that acts on any embryo; card v5 l.60 says '+0.84% nodes ~-0.0008 on any embryo'. ILP 0.4 is near-inert (+49 nodes, +3 forks). (3) 'Every fork-set lever reads 0 on 44b6' is cherry-picked. In the exp60 ALL rows, ins35 reads +0.0058 on 44b6, dc0.30 -0.0006 and dc0.35 -0.0074. The cap arms are a lab NULL: CI90 includes 0, and the sign flips when 2 clips are dropped (F-TRN-51). The public cap reads (P45 +, P47/P49 -) did not follow the lab sign, so a per-embryo lab split of fork levers says nothing about private. (4) 'B hedges geometry, ~3x larger on 44b6' extrapolates from GT-oracle truncation (-0.0131 vs -0.0043, 3x) and z shift (+0.0025 vs +0.0015, only 1.6x). Neither of these is CI. CI on 44b6 is unmeasured (the dummy clips have ~50 GT edges), and the dummy lab gives CI the wrong sign (R28 fact 6). A larger |effect| with an unknown sign means more variance, not a hedge in a known direction. (5) Action (1) is already done. round29/finals_card_v5_ru.md section 6 quotes 743006 as unverified, including 'could be a mix split'. Section 4 says all reads come from one public embryo. mc26 already models the private CI effect as one draw with a fixed sd, so 'effects do not average' adds nothing. The card's P3 line ('#37 hedges everything: cap 6, K, CI, SEC, DIS') is more accurate than the proposed A = fork-set text. Feasibility is trivial (wording only), but on value the change is ~0 at best and misleading at worst: it would tell the user that A is inert on a 44b6-like private embryo when the main V_pub-vs-#37 difference is a node lever.
